svg.title: Parc and your privacy
svg.desc: Free, and private by design: no accounts, no ads, no analytics or tracking. A dotted quarter circle marks the phone; notes, steps, books, highlights, quotes, messages, day records, the layout and reading places rest inside it. Only two thin lines leave it: Weather (Open-Meteo, rounded location) and Translate (your own DeepL key), in the public build. The personal and Play builds have no internet permission.
